title: Capital One (COF) Expected to Beat Earnings Estimates: Can the Stock Move Higher?
author: Zacks.Com
description: Capital One is expected to report a year-over-year earnings decline but revenue growth for Q3 2026. With a positive Earnings ESP of +1.50% and Zacks Rank #3 (Hold), the stock appears positioned to beat consensus EPS estimates of $5.43 per share. The company has a strong recent surprise history, beating estimates by +19.79% in the last quarter.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Capital One shows positive indicators for an earnings beat with a +1.50% Earnings ESP combined with a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold). The company has demonstrated strong recent earnings surprise history (+19.79% in the last quarter) and analysts have recently become bullish with upward estimate revisions. While earnings are expected to decline year-over-year, revenues are projected to grow 5%, and the combination of positive ESP and Hold rating suggests a ~70% probability of beating consensus estimates.

title: Why Investors Need to Take Advantage of These 2 Finance Stocks Now

description: Zacks highlights its Earnings ESP (Expected Surprise Prediction) metric as a tool for identifying stocks likely to beat quarterly earnings expectations. Both stocks show positive ESP figures, suggesting potential for earnings beats.

title: SoFi Technologies SMB Lending: Can New Loans Unlock Growth?
author: Na
description: SoFi Technologies launched small business loans in Q2 2026, targeting underserved entrepreneurs with fast funding and competitive pricing. The company is using a capital-light approach through its Loan Platform Business, with $3 billion in capacity from Basepoint Capital and additional partnerships. Total originations reached a record $14.8 billion in Q2, up 69% year-over-year, with potential for future balance sheet retention of SMB loans.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: SoFi achieved record lending originations of $14.8 billion (up 69% YoY) and successfully launched SMB loans with strong application demand. The capital-light strategy with $3 billion in partnerships provides scalability while creating a path to recurring net interest income. However, sentiment is tempered by the stock's 12.2% decline in three months and elevated valuation at 20.61X forward P/E versus industry average of 15.45X.

title: Synchrony Deepens CareCredit's Veterinary Reach With Vetspire Tie-Up
author: Na
description: Synchrony Financial is integrating CareCredit financing directly into Vetspire's AI-enabled practice management platform used by over 1,000 veterinary clinics. The partnership embeds financing options into the clinical workflow to improve treatment acceptance and efficiency. Health & Wellness purchase volume rose 2.1% year-over-year in Q2 2026, with growth driven by pet spending.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strategic partnership extends CareCredit into digital healthcare infrastructure with embedded payment options in veterinary clinics. Integration with Vetspire's 1,000+ clinics provides growth opportunity, with 85% already enrolled in CareCredit leaving 15% for incremental adoption. Q2 2026 Health & Wellness volume growth and potential to lift treatment acceptance and utilization support positive outlook.

title: WFC's Credit Rating Upgraded to 'A-' by S&P, Outlook Remains Stable
author: Na
description: S&P Global Ratings upgraded Wells Fargo's issuer credit rating to 'A-' from 'BBB+' with a stable outlook, citing significant progress in risk management, governance, and profitability. The bank has terminated 14 consent orders since 2019, expanded its balance sheet following the removal of asset caps, and increased its ROTCE target to 17%-18%. S&P also upgraded ratings for Rithm Capital and Capital One in September 2026.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: S&P upgraded WFC's credit rating from 'BBB+' to 'A-' reflecting improved risk management, terminated consent orders, removal of asset cap restrictions, expanding profitability with ROTCE rising to 16.1%, and strengthened client relationships.
